captions.sort: Walls are on A-WALL, A-WALL-PATT: 587 lines. Glass on A-GLAZ-CURT, A-GLAZ-CWMG. Door symbols on 3 door layers. Stairs on their own layers. The 24 other layers (furniture, fittings, grid, labels and the like) build no walls: the 74 furniture pieces among them become one coloured box each, the rest is left out.
captions.align: One floor, at {L1level} m: nothing to line up.

captions.raise: Walls rise to {L1height} m on Level 1; 4 lintels over the doors and windows.
captions.finish: Floor plates and room names go in, and last the furniture: 74 coloured boxes, one per piece, 8 kinds. Done: 1 level, 11 wall runs, 4 lintels, 18 glass pieces, 6 rooms named.
